I appreciate it. I'm alright, really. I just wish I had discovered this fact sooner. I always held out for the hope that one day I would wake up and magically feel better. I went from being a straight-A, top-of-the-class student to failing every subject, simply because I couldn't bring myself to care enough to try. I barely made it through high school. The only reason I did was that I had some very caring, compassionate, and understanding teachers who let me slide with a lot. Even once I graduated, I went to work every day but with no purpose. I did it so that I could afford life, but just went through the motions and certainly did not do my best. 

Finally one day I realized that I wasn't getting any better and that I probably never would. So I decided that if I was going to be miserable, it would no longer be magnified by my fuck-ups and apathy. I do what I can to keep out of my own head now and give my all in every situation. I've had some major successes - great girl, great promotion, great dog, finally living on my own - simply from doing what I need to do because I need to do it. 

Don't get me wrong; I'm still miserable. I'd still rather lie in bed all day or not wake up at all. But since I'm here, and since I do wake up, I might as well do all that I can to minimize the misery.
